description.narrative: The project is expected to increase access to affordable, high-quality goods for consumers and create job opportunities for the local people. Further, the opening of five new stores will provide business opportunities for local suppliers and increase the companies' usage of transportation and logistics services. Beyond the direct project outcomes, IFC's financing is also expected to strengthen market competitiveness through competitive pressure.

The proposed investment entails a EUR9 million IFC Loan to SANIFER SARLU and KIBO SARLU (jointly the Companies). The IFC Loan will support i) the development of five new stores (three SANIFER stores and two KIBO stores); ii) the implementation of Sage X3 ERP system; and iii) the partial refinancing of the Borrowers outstanding working capital credit facility (jointly the Project). SANIFER specializes in the import, distribution, and retail of construction, and home improvement materials while KIBO operates modern grocery retail stores.
